_comment: Maps normalized events to simple OBS actions (logOnly/switchScene/showSource/hideSource) for anything that doesn't need the richer queued/timed treatment. Gift/Join/Follow/Share/Milestone/Leaderboard/Goal/BoxBattle are actually handled in code by src/overlays/overlayDispatcher.js (real visuals, timing, queueing) - these rules just log them too, and are the extension point if you ever want to bolt on an extra simple OBS action (e.g. switchScene) alongside the built-in visual.
